basic_info.description: First time on the market in 40 years!  Updated & charming single-family home nestled in San Francisco's desirable Ingleside neighborhood. This beautifully maintained residence offers a blend of classic character and modern updates, providing both comfort and style. With 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom on the top floor, the home boasts spacious, light-filled rooms and an inviting floor plan perfect for today's lifestyle. The home has a bonus room and additional full bathroom on the first floor that is believed to be unwarranted.    Step outside to discover a large private backyard.  Just minutes from Balboa Park BART station and with easy access to I-280, this home is a commuter's dream. Set in the vibrant Ingleside community, it's surrounded by Ocean Avenue's diverse shops, cafes, and dining options, nearby parks and highly rated schools   including SF State University and City College of San Francisco,  making this an ideal choice for anyone looking for a lively, convenient San Francisco neighborhood.
